FAQ.BUG_FEATURE_A: We love feedback, this platform wouldn't be the same without it! You can report issues or suggest features through our Discord server. Player input helps us improve Talishar.
FAQ.BUG_FEATURE_Q: What if I find a bug or have suggestions?
FAQ.DOWNLOAD_NEEDED_A: No downloads required! Talishar runs directly in your web browser on desktop, tablet, or mobile.
FAQ.DOWNLOAD_NEEDED_Q: Do I need to download anything?
FAQ.HOW_CONTRIBUTER_A: Talishar is an open-source project. Head to our Discord #dev-general channel to get involved, and check our GitHub for contribution guidelines.
FAQ.HOW_CONTRIBUTER_Q: How can I become a contributor?
FAQ.HOW_SIGNUP_A: Click the 'Sign Up' button on the main page and enter your email and password. Your account is created instantly, and you can start playing right away.
FAQ.HOW_SIGNUP_Q: How do I create an account?
FAQ.IS_FREE_A: Yes! Talishar is completely free to play. You can enjoy all features without spending any money. We offer exclusive cosmetics for our supporters and those who want to help fund development.
FAQ.IS_OFFICIAL_A: Talishar is an unofficial community-created platform. It's not affiliated with Legend Story Studios.
FAQ.IS_OFFICIAL_Q: Is this an official Flesh & Blood platform?
FAQ.PLAY_OFFLINE_A: Talishar is an online platform that requires an internet connection to play. This allows you to compete against real players worldwide in real-time.
FAQ.TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.WHERE_PLAY_A: Check out LSS's official event locator to find local tournaments and events.
FAQ.WHERE_PLAY_Q: Where can I play in person?
FAQ.WHY_NO_RANKED_A: Talishar is designed as a no-stakes testing platform for players to experiment with decks and strategies. If you wish to have competitive play, head to organised play and join official Flesh and Blood tournaments!
FAQ.WHY_NO_RANKED_Q: Why is there no matchmaking or ranked play?

ABOUT.WHAT_IS_DESCRIPTION: Talishar is a passion project built by the Flesh & Blood community for the community. We created this platform to provide players with a free, accessible, and welcoming space to play and test deck ideas. Whether you're a casual player looking to learn the game before joining a local armory or a competitive player wanting some reps, Talishar is there for the community.
ABOUT.WHO_MAINTAINS_DESCRIPTION: Talishar is maintained by a dedicated team of volunteer developers and community members who are passionate about Flesh & Blood. We are in no way associated with Legend Story Studios (LSS). Our team works entirely on a volunteer basis to keep the platform running, code new card sets, fix bugs, and implement new features. We're supported by the community through optional contribution platforms such as Metafy. They help cover server costs and fund development.

PRIVACY_PAGE.AUTHORIZATION_KEY_DESCRIPTION: When you play a game on Talishar, an "authorization key" is generated for you to use to authenticate your actions on that game. This is what prevents others on the internet from executing game actions on your behalf. This authentication key is stored as a cookie in your browser. It is necessary for the operation of the game. In order to not receive this cookie, you must not play the game. If your browser blocks or clears this cookie (for example, when refusing all cookies in browser settings), you may be disconnected mid-game, unable to rejoin, and required to log in again between games.

PRIVACY_PAGE.CHILDREN_COPPA_DESCRIPTION: Talishar does not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13. Our website is not directed at children under 13, and we do not use rev.iq to target personalized ads to children. If you are under 13 years of age, please do not use our website or provide any personal information without parental consent.

PRIVACY_PAGE.COOKIE_PREFERENCES_DESCRIPTION: Essential cookies (login session, Remember Me token, and the game authorization key described above) are always active - Talishar cannot function without them. Analytics cookies are only set with your consent. You can change your consent choice at any time:

These companies may use information about your visits to this and other websites to provide relevant advertisements about goods and services.
PRIVACY_PAGE.EXERCISE_RIGHTS_DESCRIPTION: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us through our <1>Discord community</1>. PRIVACY_PAGE.GDPR_DESCRIPTION: If you are accessing Talishar from the European Economic Area (EEA), United Kingdom, or other regions with data protection laws, please note that we comply with applicable privacy regulations. You have rights regarding your personal data, including:

GDPR_RIGHTS.RESTRICT: The right to restrict or object to processing

PRIVACY_PAGE.PRIVACY_CHOICES_DESCRIPTION: You have the right to control how your data is used for advertising:
PRIVACY_PAGE.REMEMBER_ME_DESCRIPTION: If you use the Remember Me function on the page where you log in to keep yourself logged in to your browser, a code is generated and associated with your account. That code is saved in your browser as a cookie. It allows your browser to log in once your session on the server expires. To opt out of this cookie, do not use the Remember Me function.
PRIVACY_PAGE.REVIQ_ADS_DESCRIPTION: rev.iq, as a third-party vendor, uses cookies to serve ads on Talishar. rev.iq's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visit to Talishar and/or other sites on the Internet.
